classification.rationale: Men's/boys' knit jackets of 100% polyester fall under heading 6101, which covers overcoats, anoraks, windbreakers and similar knit articles other than those of heading 6103 (suit-type jackets), per GRI 1 and confirmed by chapter 61 notes. Multiple in-force NY rulings (N283232, N003938, N111600) classify materially identical 100% polyester knit men's jackets under 6101.30.2010. Since the description covers both men's and boys' without specifying proportion, the men's statistical suffix (6101.30.20.10) is used as the primary/default line, though boys' sizing would use .20.20.
